cases.sentence: Когда Израиль был ребенком, я любил ___.
cases.explain: The transitive verb любил (loved) governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: И из Египта призвал я ___ моего.
cases.explain: The transitive verb призвал (called) governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Они приносили жертвы Баалам и благовония ___.
cases.explain: The transitive verb (burnt incense to) governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Это я научил Ефрема ходить, держа его за ___.
cases.explain: The preposition за (by/at) with accusative indicates the means of taking hold.

cases.sentence: Я вел их узами любви и человеческой ___.
cases.explain: The preposition за (with) takes the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Я снял ермоз их ___ и склонился, чтобы накормить их.
cases.explain: The phrase 'снял ермо с их шеи' uses the genitive after the preposition с (from).

cases.sentence: Не вернутся ли они в Египет, и не будет ли Осирия править ими из-за того, что они отказались ___?
cases.explain: The verb отказались (refused) with preposition в takes the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Мечи засверкают в их ___, разрушат затворы их ворот.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) governs the prepositional case when indicating location.

reading.ru: Когда Израиль был ребенком, я любил его. И из Египта призвал я сына моего.
reading.question: What does God recall about Israel's childhood?
options: He loved Israel and called him out of Egypt
He punished Israel for his disobedience
He abandoned Israel in the desert
He rejected Israel as his son
reading.correct: He loved Israel and called him out of Egypt
reading.explain: God recalls 'я любил его' (I loved him) and 'из Египта призвал я сына моего' (called my son out of Egypt).

reading.ru: Но чем больше я звал израилетян, тем дальше они уходили от меня.
reading.question: How did Israel respond to God's calling?
options: The more He called them, the further they went from Him
reading.correct: The more He called them, the further they went from Him
reading.explain: The text states 'чем больше я звал израилетян, тем дальше они уходили от меня' — the more I called them, the farther they went from me.

reading.ru: Это я научил Ефрема ходить, держа его за руки. А он не осознавал, что я был и тем, кто исцелял его.
reading.question: What didn't Ephraim understand about God?
options: That God was also the one who healed him
That God had chosen him as His people
That God had given him the land
That God required him to obey the law
reading.correct: That God was also the one who healed him
reading.explain: The text says 'он не осознавал, что я был и тем, кто исцелял его' — he did not know that I healed him.

reading.ru: Я вел их узами любви и человеческой доброты. Я снял ермо с их шеи и склонился, чтобы накормить их.
reading.question: How did God treat Israel despite their unfaithfulness?
options: With cords of love, removing their yoke and feeding them
By destroying their cities and temples
By abandoning them to their enemies
reading.correct: With cords of love, removing their yoke and feeding them
reading.explain: God says He led them with cords of love, took the yoke from their neck, and bent down to feed them.

reading.ru: Как я могу оставить тебя, Ефрем? Как я могу предать тебя, Израиль? Мое сердце переменилось, пробудилась во мне жалость.
reading.question: What does God reveal about His heart regarding Israel?
options: His heart has changed within Him and His compassion has been aroused
He wants to destroy them completely
reading.correct: His heart has changed within Him and His compassion has been aroused
reading.explain: God cries out and says 'Мое сердце переменилось, пробудилась во мне жалость' — My heart is turned within me, my compassion is aroused.

reading.ru: Я не поступлю по ярости своего гнева, не разрушу Ефрема снова, потому что я — Бог, а не человек, святой среди тебя.
reading.question: Why will God not destroy Ephraim in anger?
options: Because He is God, not man, and is holy among them
Because Israel has repented of their sins
Because Israel promised to obey His law
reading.correct: Because He is God, not man, and is holy among them
reading.explain: God says 'я — Бог, а не человек, святой среди тебя' — I am God and not man; the Holy One in your midst.
